title: Free Videos, Notes and Tests to Win Students | AllCoaching
description: Share free videos, notes and sample tests that anyone can open on your website and app, and see how many students they reached and how many went on to buy.
keywords: free content for coaching, how to get students for online coaching, free demo class, course free preview, free notes for students, student engagement
lede: A free chapter, a few notes or a sample test lets students see how you teach before they pay. Put them in Free content and they show on your website and app marked Free, while the studio shows how many students they reached and how many went on to buy.

steps.d: In the studio, open Free content to see what is free and what it brought in.
Press Add, tick the videos, documents or tests to make free, and add them.
Your free content appears on your academy website and app, marked Free.
Students reached and Went on to buy show what your free content leads to.

faq.q: How do I get students for online coaching?
faq.a: Share free videos, notes and sample tests. Students get to know your teaching first, and Went on to buy shows how many of them later bought a course.

faq.q: How do I offer a free demo class?
faq.a: Add a video, document or test to Free content. It shows on your website and app marked Free, and anyone can open it without buying.

faq.q: How do I make a free course preview?
faq.a: Open the course’s Content tab and edit a module, then turn off Only for enrolled students. That module becomes a free preview anyone can open.

faq.q: Where does free content show to students?
faq.a: On your academy website under free videos, test series and notes, each marked Free, and in your app.
